en.name: Nokhatha
en.eyebrow: Open source, no account and no ads
en.hero_title: Be the captain of your home.
en.hero_lead: Nokhatha reminds you to look after your home and your car and keeps an eye on your silent subscriptions, with every date set to the Gulf's year from Suhail to Al-Kulaibain.
en.year_title: The Gulf's year in one ring
en.year_lead: People of the Gulf have long divided the year into seasons that tell the heat, the cold, the rain and the winds, and Nokhatha builds your dates on them so the ACs are serviced before Al-Kinna, the roof is checked before Al-Wasm and the car is ready before the summer.
en.year_note: Season names and start dates follow the traditional calendar used in Kuwait and across the Gulf, which starts the year with the rising of Suhail on 24 August. Start dates can differ by a day or two from one area to another.
en.features_lead: Every task tells you when and why, in plain words, and you can mark it done with one tap, snooze it or change how often it comes.
en.home_body: AC filters every month and every two weeks in the Bawarih, AC servicing before the summer, the water tank, filter and heater, the roof, the kitchen hood, pest control, smoke alarms and the extinguisher, with a list for every house, chalet or farm.
en.car_body: Oil and filters by kilometres or time, whichever comes first, an odometer estimated from your readings, tires, battery and car AC before the summer, and registration, insurance and inspection before they expire.
en.subs_body: See what you pay each month and each year, and before every renewal you are asked whether you still use it so you can cancel what you don't need before the money leaves, with a reminder before free trials end.
en.x_warranty: Warranties with a receipt photo and a reminder a month before they end
en.x_techs: Your technicians with call and WhatsApp next to their tasks
en.x_travel: A checklist before the summer trip
en.x_spend: Yearly spend for home, car and subscriptions
en.x_calendar: Export your dates to your phone's calendar
en.privacy_title: Your data stays on your device
en.privacy_lead: No account needed because your data never leaves your device, no analytics or ads watch what you do, and the app works offline after the first visit.
en.p1_body: Tasks, subscriptions and receipt photos stay in your browser or on your phone and the dates are worked out on the device itself, and none of it reaches us because we have no server that receives data at all.
en.p2_body: Backups are encrypted with AES-256-GCM using a key derived from your passphrase, so nobody else can open them.
en.p3_body: A strict content security policy stops the app from talking to any other site, and every font and image is served from the same origin.
en.p4_body: The full code is published under the MIT licence, so you can review it yourself, build it and improve it.
en.platforms_lead: The same engine and the same dates on every device, and the same backup file opens in every version.
en.web_body: Available now on any device, and you can add it to your home screen.
en.ios_body: With device notifications and a home screen widget.
en.android_body: With device notifications and a home screen widget.
en.meaning: The nokhatha was the captain of the pearling ship and answered for everything aboard, and this app makes you the nokhatha of your home.
en.q1: With no account, where is my data kept?
en.a1: On your device, in the browser's or the app's storage, and it never leaves it, so we have no need to know who you are.
en.q2: With no server, how does it keep track of my dates and remind me?
en.a2: Your device works out each date from the last time you logged the task and from the Gulf's seasons, so you see what is due as soon as you open the app. You can export the dates to your phone's calendar for a 9 am alert, and the upcoming iPhone and Android apps will send device notifications with no server.
en.a3: No analytics, trackers or ads watch what you do, so we cannot see who uses the app or what they record. The files download from GitHub on your first visit like any website, but your data never leaves your device.
en.q4: What if I change phones or clear my browser data?
en.a4: Your data goes with it, because no copy exists anywhere else. Save an encrypted backup from Settings and open it on the new device with your passphrase.
en.q5: I use it on an iPhone, what should I do?
en.a5: Add it to your home screen from the Share button, then Add to Home Screen. Safari clears data for websites you have not opened for a while, and installed web apps are exempt.
